# Rationale
In the discovery cases definition, I included individuals with death/hospitalisation for asthma who also present a diagnosis for comorbidities;
Comorbidities are defined as COPD and/or emphysema/chronic bronchitis.
<br>
Among the 7,681 cases, I had included 1,488 with either death/hospitalisation with also a diagnosis for comorbidities.
This represents a modest percentage of our cases (19.37%).
We checked some physiological parameters including fev1 (% predicted), fev1/fvc, and BMI comparing cases with comorbidities (1,488)
and without comorbidities (6,193): the cases with comorbidities showed lower respiratory capacity and higher BMI.
<br>
Therefore, based on teh difference in physiological features, we decided to run a sensitivity analysis: we excluded the cases with comorbidities and
we wanted to assess if the associated variants showed the same direction of effect of the discovery analysis.

# Analysis
We performed a GWAS analysis using REGENIE (v3.2.1) with 6,193 cases-no comorbidity- and 38,405 controls.
The number of controls is the same as in the discovery analysis (ratio case:control is 1:6, higher than the discovery which is 1:5).
We then compared the results for the suggestive signals, looking at the p-value and effect size.

# Results
The GWAS analysis showed a LDSC intercept of 1.02 suggesting no further correction needed to the statistics.
<br>
The sensitivity analysis results showed the same direction of effect of the discovery analysis. For some variants, the p-value is less significant.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
dt <- fread("/home/n/nnp5/PhD/PhD_project/tmp_manuscript/output/sensitivity_nocomob_suggestive_discovery.txt",header=T)
dt$'OR_95_CI' <- paste0(format(round(dt$odds_ratio,2),nsmall=2)," [",format(round(dt$ci_lower,2),nsmall=2),"-",format(round(dt$ci_upper,2),nsmall=2),"]")
dt <- dt %>% select(c("SNP_UKB","chr","pos_b37","pos_b38","EA","NEA","pval","pval_no_comob","OR_95_CI","OR_95_CI_no_comob","concordance_nocomob",))
dt$pval_no_comob <- formatC(dt$pval_no_comob, format = "e", digits = 2)
dt$pval <- formatC(dt$pval, format = "e", digits = 2)


kbl(dt) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"))
```
